tools.name: list_program_templates
tools.description: List Superset's published training program templates. Returns each template's slug, name, description, and public URL.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Get the title, description, and URL of a Superset marketing page by its path, e.g. "/platform" or "/training".

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get the cheapest Superset plan for a coach with this many clients, with its monthly and yearly cost. Base takes 4% of client payments; Pro and Business take none. Pass monthly_client_payments to count that fee.

tools.name: compare_with
tools.description: Compare Superset with another coaching app, e.g. Trainerize or TrueCoach. Returns the compare page's feature table, how each app handles a coach's tasks, and both sides' prices, each with its source URL and check date.

tools.name: find_template
tools.description: Find Superset's free training program templates for a goal, e.g. 'strength' or 'marathon'. Returns up to 5 matches with their public URLs.

tools.name: request_coach_trial
tools.description: Request a free Superset coach trial for the person you work for. The Superset team gets their name and email and follows up with them. Ask for their consent first.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_program_templates, get_page, compare_with · Public sink: request_coach_trial.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_program_templates, get_page, compare_with · Public sink: request_coach_trial

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
